messages:
emma: Heads-up — we’re planning the v2 rollout to default traffic at 2024-08-21T22:00Z (change window). Can folks confirm client pinlist status and any last-minute hold requests?

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @emma at 2024-08-21T22:00Z. Canary at 10% for 15m, then 50% for 20m, then 100% if green. Auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate > 3% OR p95 latency increase > 40%.

jon: Thanks. Two quick asks: 1) mobile SDK still has ~0.5% of clients sending v1-only header; 2) do we have a tenant-level pin list ready if we need to cut traffic?

maria: Mobile SDK team confirmed they shipped the header normalization patch but older installs will still exist. I uploaded the current pinlist to S3: s3://rwd-release/pins/2024-08-21.json. Contains 1,124 tenant ids (mostly internal/test).

emma: Copy. @dan can you keep the tenant pin CLI ready? If the canary shows regressions we’ll pin at route level.

dan: ready. CLI snippet:
```
rwdctl pins add --route /api/v2 --tenants-file pins/2024-08-21.json --reason "v2 canary fallback"
```

jon: What’s rollback playbook look like? If deploy-bot auto-rolls back, do we still need manual pin?

maria: Auto-rollback will revert the new gateway config. Manual pin is separate — useful for targeted mitigation while we debug. Prefer: let deploy-bot rollback if broad failure, otherwise manual pin to protect high-risk tenants and keep rollout on schedule.

emma: Agreed. Also adding release notes blurb: "v2 default routing; clients without updated header will be served compatible v1 shim — we recommend updating SDKs." Can someone quick-review wording?

jon: Can we add an explicit known issue about streaming chunking differences (mobile edge)? Seen minor truncation in internal tests.

maria: Added: "Known issue: streaming chunk boundaries may differ under v2; affects older mobile SDKs. No data loss; recommend SDK upgrade"

sre-oncall: Monitoring links: metrics.rwd/inference/v2-canary, logs.rwd/logs?query=canary. I’ll watch error_rate, p95, and per-tenant surge. I’ll also enable alert: canary_error_rate > 1.5% for 5m -> page.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2024-08-21T22:00Z: traffic 10%.

emma: Observability — look at per-region p95. If EU shows >25% latency increase we hold.

jon: Seeing a small uptick in EU p95 already (12% -> 18%). Not alarming but keeping an eye.

maria: Error count stable. No customer-facing 5xxs in the last 5m.

dan: v1 header metric: 0.47% of requests still v1-only. Will keep pin CLI on standby.

sre-oncall: Alert triggered: eu-canary-p95 spike to +42% for 6m. Pageing oncall.

emma: Ok triggering manual mitigation. @dan run pin for the EU-heavy tenants list and pause the canary.

dan: Running command now.

dan: Command output:
```
Applying pins from pins/eu-heavy.json to /api/v2...
Success: 312 tenants pinned.
```

deploy-bot: Canary paused by operator @emma at 2024-08-21T22:10Z. Deploybot will stop further traffic increase.

maria: Rolling back? With pins applied we can iterate on kernel selector for EU region, then resume. Rolling back would be heavier. Thoughts?

jon: Prefer to keep rollback off the table for now — pins should buy time to fix perf regression in the EU path. If we see error_rate rise we’ll flip rollback.

emma: Agreed. Action items: 1) SRE to triage EU perf (sre-oncall), 2) runtime team to test kernel selector tweak and stage a hotfix (maria), 3) mobile docs update for header normalization (jon). I’ll update release notes with the temporary hold and tenant pin details.

sre-oncall: Started investigation — possible cold-cache effect on EU shard due to different sequence length distribution. Collecting flamegraphs now.

maria: I’ll build a candidate with adjusted kernel selection and point it at a staging shard for benching. ETA 25m.

emma: Thanks. Keep this thread for handoff. We’ll mark the rollout as "paused with targeted pins" in the release tracker.

jon: Noting rollback criteria again: immediate rollback if global error_rate > 3% OR sustained p95 increase > 40% across regions. Otherwise keep pins and iterate.

dan: Confirmed pins can be reverted with `rwdctl pins remove --file pins/eu-heavy.json` once fix validated.

deploy-bot: Canary remains paused. Manual operator action recorded by @emma.

emma: Closing operator window for now. I’ll reopen when kernel fix validated. Thanks all :thumbsup:
